battle.name: 秦滅魏之戰
battle.brief: 公元前225年，秦將王賁率大軍東出，圍困魏都大梁。圍城既久，秦軍絕其糧道、斷其漕運，魏王請和不得，外援不至，終至大梁陷落，魏王被俘，魏國遂亡。此役是秦滅六國的倒數第二場，弩手與車兵在城壘與野道之間轉換，最終決定了中原最後一個大國的存亡。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 秦滅魏之戰是秦王政二十二年（公元前225年）秦軍攻滅魏國的戰役，交戰的一方是關中的秦國，一方是都於大梁的魏國。秦一方由秦王政在咸陽坐鎮決策，丞相王綰、廷尉李斯等在朝中商定方略，前線交由將軍王賁統率大軍；秦在滅韓（公元前230年）、滅趙（公元前228年）之後已接管韓、趙故地，東進的通道被打開，關中與巴蜀的糧秣經渭水、黃河一路轉輸，前線大軍得以長期駐紮而不虞斷炊。魏一方是魏王假居於大梁，宗室與朝臣多為文吏，將領中已無能獨當一面的名將；國土只剩下睢、泗之間的舊地，首都大梁有吳起所訓的魏武卒為精銳，身披重甲、操重弩，然則總兵力與後勤都遠不及秦國。戰前秦已先取魏河西之地，其後又在楚地取得黔中，魏國東南方向的屏障亦被削去；與此同時，秦在楚、齊兩線仍留有重兵，形成多面同時施壓的格局。
countriesEn: The war that ended the state of Wei was fought in the twenty-second year of King Zheng of Qin (225 BCE), between the Qin state of the Guanzhong basin and the state of Wei whose capital was Daliang. On the Qin side, King Zheng himself sat in Xianyang making the decisions, with Chancellor Wang Wan and the Tingwei Li Si conferring in court on the plan of campaign, while the field army was entrusted to the general Wang Ben. After the destruction of Han in 230 BCE and of Zhao in 228 BCE, Qin held the former lands of both states, the road east was open, and grain from Guanzhong and Bashu could be moved down the Wei and the Yellow River to keep a large army in the field for as long as the siege required. On the Wei side sat King Jia of Wei in Daliang; most of the royal clan and the court were literati rather than soldiers, and the state no longer possessed a general capable of holding a front on his own. Wei's territory had shrunk to the old lands between the Sui and the Si rivers; the capital held the Wei Wuzu, elite infantry trained by Wu Qi, who wore heavy armour and worked heavy crossbows, but their numbers and their supply lines were in no way comparable with those of Qin. Before the campaign Qin had already taken the Wei lands west of the Yellow River, and later seized Qinzhong in Chu territory, so Wei's southern screen was gone as well; at the same time Qin still kept major armies on the Chu and the Qi fronts, which produced pressure from several directions at once.
people: 前線主將是將軍王賁，他此前在攻趙、攻燕諸役中已練出奔襲與持久兩種打法，滅魏之役仍由他領兵。咸陽方面的決策者是秦王政本人，這場戰爭是統一工程中倒數第二枚棋子，戰略由君臣商定後一次押上。同一時期秦的其他將領蒙武、蒙恬分別在楚、齊戰線作戰，使魏國無法借合縱聯軍取得實援。魏國方面的核心人物是末代國君魏王假，他在公元前225年出降被俘；魏國最負盛名的統兵者信陵君魏無忌約在公元前242年前後病故，至此魏國既無能統合諸軍挽回士氣的人物，也失去了最足以號召諸侯的招牌。朝中另有割地求和與堅持抵抗兩派意見相持，最後請和不成，國脈遂絕。大梁守軍多為宿將，攻城之後大批魏人北走燕齊或南奔楚地，人才與戶口隨之流失，也讓此後秦統治中原時少了中間層的緩衝。
peopleEn: The field commander was the general Wang Ben, who had already developed both the fast raid and the protracted siege in the earlier campaigns against Zhao and Yan, and who led the army that destroyed Wei. The decision-maker in Xianyang was King Zheng himself: this war was the second to last piece on the board of the unification project, and the strategy was settled between ruler and ministers and then committed in a single throw. Elsewhere in the same period Qin's commanders Meng Wu and Meng Tian were operating on the Chu and the Qi fronts, so that Wei could not draw any real support from a coalition of the six states. The central figure on the Wei side was King Jia of Wei, the last ruler of the state, who surrendered and was taken prisoner in 225 BCE. Wei's most famous commander, the Lord of Xinling, Wei Wuji, had died around 242 BCE; from then on the state had neither a man who could unite the armies and rally the fighting spirit nor a name that could summon the lords of the realm. In court, the party favouring cession and peace and the party favouring continued resistance deadlocked, and the peace that was finally requested was refused, so the life of the state was cut off. The garrison of Daliang was made up largely of old officers, and after the city fell many Wei people fled north to Yan and Qi or south into Chu, carrying the state's talent and registered households with them and leaving the Qin regime that later governed the Central Plain without the buffer of a local middle order.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長弓是已知最早的成熟複合弓形制之一，公元前七世紀的亞述人以木胎配角、筋三層複合，弓臂修長、箭身近一米，配銅或鐵的三棱箭鏃，是亞述軍隊在兩河流域作戰的標準武器，也是「弓兵在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路」這套戰法的物質基礎。必須說明的是，這件兵器本身從未出現在中國戰場；秦魏兩軍手中與它同族的，是自緊式角弓與弩。魏武卒操十二石之弩、負矢五十，是當時最重型的單兵投射兵器，弩機在河南固始、輝縣一帶的楚魏墓葬中均有出土，銅弩機配木弩臂，張合全靠人力絞弦。弓兵之外，兩軍都配長柄的戈、矛、戟與近身短兵劍，身著皮甲或綴甲的金屬甲片，戰車與載重的牛馬構成後勤。河南輝縣魏國墓葬出土大量鐵斧、鐵削、鐵鏃，說明戰國晚期鐵器已進入軍備；攻城則靠深溝高壘、雲梯、箭樓與穴地。糧秣方面，秦靠關中水利供應，運糧車隊沿渭水、黃河東運，車馬以千乘計。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is one of the earliest mature composite bow designs known: the Assyrians of the seventh century BCE built the bow from a wooden core faced with horn and sinew in three layers, with a long limb and an arrow nearly a metre long, tipped with a bronze or iron three-edged point, and it was the standard weapon of the Assyrian army in Mesopotamia, the material basis of the doctrine in which archers shoot from the chariot and the chariotry opens the road behind them. It must be said that this weapon never appeared on a Chinese battlefield; the counterparts in the hands of the Qin and the Wei were the self-tensioned horn bows and the crossbow. The Wei Wuzu operated crossbows of twelve stone draw-weight and carried fifty arrows apiece, the heaviest man-portable missile weapon of the age; crossbow locks have been excavated from Chu and Wei tombs around Gushi and Huixian in Henan, a bronze lock fitted to a wooden stock, cocked entirely by hand. Beyond the missile troops, both armies carried long-handled ge, mao, ji and short swords for close work, and wore hide armour or metal plates bound on leather; chariots and draft animals formed the logistics. The Wei tombs at Huixian in Henan have yielded large quantities of iron axes, iron knives and iron arrowheads, showing that iron had already entered the military inventory of the late Warring States; siege work relied on deep trenches and raised ramparts, ladders, arrow towers and mining. On the supply side Qin drew on the waterworks of Guanzhong, and the grain wagons moved east along the Wei and the Yellow River in thousands of teams.
tactics: 秦軍沒有急攻大梁。公元前227年前後大軍抵達後即在城外結壘，挖塹壕、修土壘，圍而不打，把圍城拖成持久戰，同時分兵向西北與西南切斷由黃河、睢水通往大梁的漕運與糧道，令城內外斷絕。弩手列陣於營壘與土壘之後，壓制城頭守軍，使魏軍不能自如出城；車兵在兩翼巡行，護住運糧通道與攻城器械。攻城時秦軍仍用其慣用之法：先以連續射擊與築壘消耗守軍，再以雲梯、穴地與正面突擊同時施壓，必要時分出一支直趨糧道。情報與心理戰同樣被使用，《戰國策》一類文獻記載魏方曾遣人夜入秦軍、造謠焚偽書，使秦軍疑懼而退，得緩兵之計；但這類手段終究改變不了力量對比，秦軍退開之後不久即再合圍，最終以絕糧與攻堅收效。
tacticsEn: Qin did not rush Daliang. When the army reached the outskirts in about 227 BCE it at once entrenched outside the city, digging trenches and raising earthen ramparts, besieging without storming, turning the siege into a war of attrition, while detachments cut the grain road and the water-borne supply lines that ran from the Yellow River and the Sui water into Daliang, severing the city from the outside. Crossbowmen drew up behind the camps and the ramparts and kept the defenders on the walls pinned, so that the Wei troops could not sortie freely; charioteers patrolled the two flanks, guarding the transport route and the siege engines. In the actual assault Qin still used its habitual method: continuous shooting and the raising of works to wear down the defenders, followed by ladders, mining and a frontal blow applied together, and when necessary a detachment sent straight at the grain road. Information work and psychological warfare were used as well; texts such as the Zhanguoce record that the Wei side sent men into the Qin camp at night to spread rumours and burn forged documents, which made the Qin army uneasy and withdrew, buying time for the city; but such devices could not change the balance of forces, and the Qin army, having drawn back, soon closed the ring again, finally winning by the strangulation of supplies and the weight of the assault.
data: 時間上，秦軍自公元前227年圍大梁，至公元前225年破城，相持約兩年，一般記作逾年之圍。兵數方面有「二十萬圍大梁」之說；同期秦軍的規模可作對照：攻趙用兵二十萬，攻楚由王翦帶六十萬，攻齊由蒙恬領三十萬，可見秦國同時維持數十萬大軍於數條戰線。魏國方面，疆域已縮至睢泗間的數縣之地，能戰之兵主要是魏武卒這類精銳，重裝重弩而糧秣消耗極大，總量有限。城池方面，考古測算魏都大梁內城佔地數平方公里，外郭範圍更廣，夯土城垣高厚非一日之功。糧食一端，秦以關中渠堰之利支撐，鄭國渠成之後溉田四萬餘頃，秦川因之富足；魏都大梁則靠睢水、汴水一線的渠系維持生計，一旦漕運被掐，城內軍民的糧食立刻成為瓶頸。
dataEn: As to time, the Qin army began surrounding Daliang in 227 BCE and took the city in 225 BCE, a siege that dragged on roughly two years and is usually described as lasting more than a full year. As to numbers, the received figure is an army of some two hundred thousand surrounding Daliang. The scale of Qin's armies elsewhere at the same time serves as a comparison: twenty ten-thousands against Zhao, sixty ten-thousands under Wang Jian against Chu, and thirty ten-thousands under Meng Tian against Qi, which shows that Qin could keep several hundreds of thousands of men in the field on several fronts at once. On the Wei side the territory had shrunk to a handful of counties between the Sui and the Si rivers, and the only troops worth the name were elite formations like the Wei Wuzu, heavily armed and heavily supplied with bolts, but few in number. As to the city, archaeological reckoning puts the inner town of Wei's capital Daliang at several square kilometres, with a far larger outer circuit, and its rammed-earth walls were raised to great height and thickness over a long period. On the food side Qin was carried by the irrigation works of Guanzhong: once the Zhengguo Canal was completed it watered more than forty thousand qing of land and the Qin plain grew rich. Daliang, by contrast, drew its living from the channels of the Sui and the Bian, and once the water-borne supply was cut the food of the troops and the populace inside became the bottleneck at once.
cause: 秦要滅魏，一半是地緣，一半是制度。魏國據有睢、泗之間的平原，扼住秦軍東出的孔道；自商鞅變法之後秦國以耕戰立國，兵源與糧源都靠關中與巴蜀，佔領魏地便可把中原最富庶的一片納入版圖。遠交近攻的總戰略在魏身上運作得最充分：秦先取河西之地，前293年魏軍攻入秦河西，華陽一戰被秦軍擊敗，斬首以萬計，魏不得已割河西之地予秦，秦遂置上郡，魏的西面屏障自此消失。前278年前後秦取黔中，南面的牽制也隨之解除。戰前秦已滅韓、滅趙，魏國東西兩翼的援手被先後斬斷；蘇秦倡導的合縱自蘇秦死後已名存實亡，魏王假指望合縱再撐一年，卻找不到可以依靠的援軍；魏國自身的謀主與名將相繼凋零，國策在求和與死守之間反覆，士氣與糧秣一同耗盡。
causeEn: Qin's destruction of Wei was half geography and half institution. Wei held the plain between the Sui and the Si rivers and choked the corridor through which Qin's armies marched east; and since the reforms of Shang Yang Qin had been a state raised on agriculture and war, drawing its soldiers and its grain from Guanzhong and Bashu, so that seizing Wei's lands would fold the richest part of the Central Plain into the empire. The general strategy of befriending the distant and attacking the near worked most completely on Wei: Qin took the lands west of the Yellow River first; in 293 BCE the Wei army penetrated into Qin's Hexi, was beaten at the battle of Huayang with a loss counted in tens of thousands, and Wei was compelled to cede the Hexi lands to Qin, whereupon Qin enfeoffed the commandery of Shangjun and Wei's western screen disappeared for good. Around 278 BCE Qin took Qinzhong and the southern distraction was removed in turn. Before the campaign Qin had already destroyed Han and Zhao, so the helpers on Wei's eastern and western flanks were cut off one after another; the vertical alliance promoted by Su Qin had been nominal in truth since Su Qin's death, and King Jia of Wei, hoping to hold out for one more year on the strength of that alliance, could find no ally on whom to rely; meanwhile Wei's own strategists and generals died off in succession, the state's policy oscillated between seeking peace and holding out to the death, and morale and supplies were exhausted together.
impact: 魏亡之後，秦的東進再無大國阻擋，前223年滅楚、前221年滅齊，六年之間完成統一，嬴政自稱皇帝，廢分封而行郡縣，統一文字、度量衡與車軌。魏地的大梁、陶、睢一帶納入秦的郡縣體系，其人口、賦稅、鹽鐵與水利灌溉成為秦國經營中原的基礎，漢代在這一帶設置的郡縣，多沿用秦時的框架。魏國的制度經驗也被秦吸收：李悝變法所成的《法經》與魏國在編戶齊民、獎勵耕戰方面的做法，成為秦律與秦制的底色之一。另一方面，戰國晚期的鐵器化在此役之後加速推進，輝縣、固始一帶墓葬中出土的鐵鏃、鐵斧，說明中原的軍備正從銅兵轉向鐵兵，弓弩與鐵箭的組合從此成為軍隊常制。魏國的人才也隨國滅而流散，一部分北走燕齊，一部分南奔楚地。
impactEn: After the fall of Wei nothing large stood in the way of Qin's advance east; Chu was destroyed in 223 BCE and Qi in 221 BCE, and within six years the unification was complete, Ying Zheng took the title of emperor, the enfeoffment of lords was abandoned in favour of commanderies and counties, and script, weights and measures and the gauge of the cart were made uniform. The lands of Wei, Daliang, Tao and Sui, were drawn into the Qin system of commanderies and counties, and their population, taxes, salt and iron and irrigation works became the base on which Qin administered the Central Plain; the commanderies that the Han later set in this region largely followed the framework Qin had laid down. Wei's institutional experience was absorbed as well: the Code of Li Kui that emerged from Wei's reforms, together with Wei's practice of registering households and rewarding tillage and war, became one of the foundations of Qin's law and institutions. At the same time, the shift of the late Warring States toward iron accelerated after this war; the iron arrowheads and iron axes from the tombs around Huixian and Gushi show that the armament of the Central Plain was moving from bronze to iron, and the combination of bow, crossbow and iron arrow became the standing equipment of armies. Wei's talent scattered with the state, some going north to Yan and Qi, some south into Chu.
result: 公元前225年秋末，秦軍攻破大梁，魏王假出降被俘，魏國就此滅亡；自周威烈王二十一年（前403年）受封為諸侯至滅亡，魏國在中原前後存續一百七十餘年。魏地隨即分置郡縣，編入秦的版圖；王賁於同年病卒軍中，其子王喜接領兵權，隨大軍轉戰齊地。楚國在前223年被王翦、蒙武所破，齊國在前221年不戰而降，嬴政於是稱「皇帝」，統一帝制自此在中原建立；而這場戰役留下的最大教訓，是攻堅之戰最終由糧道與持久力決定——魏武卒的裝備再精良，也擋不住一場把圍城打到極致的消耗戰。
resultEn: In the late autumn of 225 BCE the Qin army broke into Daliang, King Jia of Wei surrendered and was taken prisoner, and the state of Wei was extinguished; from its enfeoffment as a feudal lord in the twenty-first year of King Weilie of Zhou, 403 BCE, to its end, Wei had stood in the Central Plain for a little more than a hundred and seventy years. The Wei lands were at once divided into commanderies and counties and folded into the Qin order of things. Wang Ben died of illness in the same year in the field, and his son Wang Xi took over the command and went on with the great army against Qi. Chu was broken by Wang Jian and Meng Wu in 223 BCE, and Qi capitulated without a battle in 221 BCE; Ying Zheng thereupon took the title of emperor, and the unified imperial system was thereby established in the Central Plain. The greatest lesson the war leaves behind is that an assault on a walled city is decided in the end by the grain road and by endurance: however fine the equipment of the Wei Wuzu, it could not stand against a war of attrition carried to its extreme around the walls.
